title: 😲 12 Saal Ke Ladke ne Puppy Ke Liye LEGO Wheelchair Banaya , viral puppy video 2026, disabled
description:
Aaya Sher song The Paradise 😱 Puppy dumped at vet, covered in maggots, missing BOTH front legs!
But a 12 saal ka ladka built her a custom LEGO wheelchair & gave her life back! 🧱🐶
This viral motivational story of how the 12 year old boy builds LEGO wheelchair for puppy will melt every heart. The abandoned puppy was hopping on back legs, risking permanent spine damage.
One creative kid stepped up — using only his LEGO set he made a sturdy base, added wheels and soft foam cushions for the perfect LEGO wheelchair for puppy. She was scared at first but treats helped her trust it. He upgraded the LEGO wheelchair for puppy multiple times as she grew, and after months of practice… she runs free and happy!
The boy builds LEGO wheelchair for puppy story proves kindness + creativity = real miracles. No age limit, no big budget needed. Pure motivation for every Indian youth and family!
